notes: TROOP 0.3.10 lowers the detailed angel wings to natural mid-back anchors, makes the minimap heading-up only while driving the locally controlled vehicle, and adds a brief local hit marker for projectile body and scored-headshot hits on other players. High-speed traversal now uses a swept predictive streaming corridor with separately bounded terrain, collision, and detail work, while the far canopy gains low-cost deterministic relief at the stratos tier. The daylight sun is three times larger and each shared world seed has a deterministic 30% chance to give it a cheerful :D face.
